# tag in scheme

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:tagInScheme`](gmeow-tagInScheme.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tagInScheme>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/tags`](../../slices/tags.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a tag to a scheme it belongs to. Non-functional: a tag may reside in many schemes (cross-listing).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Tag`](../classes/gmeow-Tag.md) -> [`gmeow:TagScheme`](../classes/gmeow-TagScheme.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:tagInScheme`](gmeow-tagInScheme.md) from [`gmeow:Tag`](../classes/gmeow-Tag.md) to [`gmeow:TagScheme`](../classes/gmeow-TagScheme.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to place a tag in one or more namespaced schemes — a personal bucket, a project vocabulary, or a controlled vocabulary — including cross-listing the same tag across several.

### Avoid when

- Avoid confusing it with the scheme a particular tagging act ran under (use [`gmeow:taggingScheme`](gmeow-taggingScheme.md) on the relator, which is functional); membership here is many-valued and lives on the tag itself.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:tagInScheme`](gmeow-tagInScheme.md) from the tag to each [`gmeow:TagScheme`](../classes/gmeow-TagScheme.md) it belongs to; a tag with no scheme is a bare folksonomy term, and cross-listing is just several assertions.

### Examples

- ex:tagUrgent [`gmeow:tagInScheme`](gmeow-tagInScheme.md) ex:projectVocab.
